Keywords: Household market detours in eastern Europe
RagShortTexts: Thaw and rain slow carts, animals and walkers differently on each road.
Mud disrupts milling, fuel and markets; detours and repairs consume household resources.

Variants.Content: Thaw and repeated rain soften many earth roads, flooding low ground and making slopes slippery while higher tracks may remain open. Recent weather matters to choosing a route. Armies, milling trips, fuel and markets all suffer. Repairs require timber and labor; detours add provisions and lodging, forcing plans to follow conditions.

A market trip can consume a day freeing a cart. More goods burden the team; fewer may not buy needed tools, prompting shared carriage. Families check passage and turning places and retain return food rather than rely on ordinary travel times.
